display.purpose: The light page heading beside its pictogram tile.

verdict.purpose: Allow / Check the driver on the gate's lit sign; 2.1rem under 640px.

label.purpose: Field labels, Slate; status legends at 0.82rem.

plate.purpose: Number-plate characters, sized in plate millimetres and trimmed to cap height.

permit-term.purpose: Academic term on the permit sign, e.g. 2025/26.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Transient toast; one of only two floating things.

shadows.name: dialog
shadows.purpose: Modal dialog, over rgba(8, 20, 45, .55) with a 2px backdrop blur.

shadows.name: scan-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow on the scanner sweep line during its single pass.

shadows.name: plate-rim
shadows.purpose: Outline that lets a white plate read on a white surface.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus everywhere; fields use outline-offset 0 with an Ink border instead of the ink halo.

motion.name: ease-in
motion.purpose: Exits: toast hide, sign-in unhook, rows leaving.

motion.name: feedback
motion.purpose: Hover, border, colour and press feedback; buttons scale .97 on press.

motion.name: section-enter
motion.value: rise 320ms ease-out, 8px; children delayed 0 / 40 / 80ms; rows fade 300ms at 120ms

motion.name: nav-bar
motion.purpose: The yellow you-are-here bar slides to the new section.

motion.name: gate-sweep
motion.purpose: Scan line passes down the plate frame after a gate record.

motion.name: verdict-light
motion.value: light-up 450ms ease-out (brightness 1.6 to none) + tile-in 320ms at 60ms from scale .7
motion.purpose: The verdict sign lights and its pictogram tile lands.

motion.name: plate-fly
motion.value: 420ms cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1), from input rect to verdict plate
motion.purpose: The typed plate travels into the verdict (JS, Web Animations).

motion.name: row-flash
motion.purpose: The newest gate row flashes its verdict tint.

motion.name: row-leave
motion.value: slide-out 220ms ease-in, 16px right (approved: 320ms with allow tint)
motion.purpose: Handled approvals leave before the list refreshes.

motion.name: loading-bar
motion.value: 3px bar, progress 1.1s infinite; white over the band, navy on sign-in

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Entrances, verdict and dialog become 200ms fades; sweep, nudge, press scale and plate flight are removed; nav bar jumps.

components.css: .ds-verdict { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; gap: 6px 22px; align-items: start; padding: 24px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: #0f7b45; color: #fff; font: 400 16px/1.55 Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; animation: ds-light .45s ease-out both; } .ds-verdict.ds-check { background: #b8232b; } .ds-verdict p { margin: 0; } .ds-vtile { grid-row: span 2; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 2px; background: #fff; color: #0f7b45; } .ds-check .ds-vtile { color: #b8232b; } .ds-vtile svg { width: 44px; height: 44px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-vword { font: 700 3rem/1 Overpass, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; padding-top: 4px; } @keyframes ds-light { 0% { opacity: 0; filter: brightness(1.6) saturate(.6); } 40% { opacity: 1; } 100% { filter: none; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-verdict { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The campus gate is a terminal. Every screen says where you are and where to go in the calm, bright language of airport signage: navy sign panels carry white legends, a single wayfinding yellow marks "you are here", and work happens on a bright, quiet hall floor. The system answers a request for something "more futuristic and also minimalistic" with signage rather than effects: light, wide headings, one-device-pixel rules, square pictogram tiles, and one authored moment at the gate where a scan line sweeps the plate and the verdict lights up like a backlit sign.

Density is moderate and administrative. Pages are a single 1080px column; records read as ledgers straight off the hall floor, and white surfaces appear only where you act. Light is the default; dark mode follows the operating system automatically and keeps the same sign logic with a deeper navy.

The ADA logomark and ADA blue are binding brand commitments; the navy sign is that blue. The world refuses the grey SaaS card dashboard and the dark neon HUD.
keyCharacteristics: A navy sign band with white section legends; the current one carries a 4px yellow bar.
Light (300) Overpass page headings beside a navy pictogram tile, standing on a hairline.
Hairlines are one device pixel; corners are 4px, tiles 2px.
White cards for actions, ruled ledgers for records.
Real Azerbaijani number plates drawn to AZS 599-2015 in Barlow Semi Condensed.
The gate verdict is a solid lit sign: green Allow or red Check the driver.

rules.name: The You-Are-Here Rule
rules.body: Wayfinding yellow marks location (the current nav legend), focus, and selection. Nothing else: no yellow edges, loading bars, buttons, badges or highlights.

rules.name: The Lit Sign Rule
rules.body: Solid colour fields are signs: navy for place, green or red for the gate verdict. Status everywhere else is a tint behind coloured ink with a small lit square.

rules.name: The Light Sign Rule
rules.body: Page headings are light (300) and wide, never bold; weight is reserved for the verdict.

rules.name: The Plates Only Rule
rules.body: Barlow Semi Condensed appears only on plates and the permit term.

rules.name: The Nothing Floats Rule
rules.body: Toast and dialog are the only elevated things. Cards, permits, verdicts and sign-in are flat.

rules.name: The One Device Pixel Rule
rules.body: Rules are `1px`, or `.5px` at 2dppx and above, so every hairline is one device pixel.

dos: Do keep Wayfinding Yellow to the current-section bar, the focus ring and selection.
Do put records in ledgers on the hall (1px Ink header rule, hairline rows) and keep white cards for things the user acts on.
Do open every section with the page sign: navy pictogram tile, light 300 heading, hairline beneath.
Do draw plates with the shared plate component and unit system; never type a plate as plain text.
Do show permanence: replaced and rejected statuses are struck through, void permits fade their plate, nothing is removed from view.
Do keep the gate's vocabulary "Allow" / "Check the driver"; the gate advises, it does not block.
Do give every movement a fade-only or static path under reduced motion.
Do keep hairlines to one device pixel and corners to 4px (2px for inner tiles).
donts: Don't use yellow for edges, loading bars, buttons, badges or emphasis.
Don't wrap record lists in white cards.
Don't add shadows to cards, permits or verdicts; only toast and dialog float.
Don't set page headings bold or use Barlow Semi Condensed outside plates and the permit term.
Don't add a second authored animation; the gate is the one moment.
Don't drift toward the grey SaaS card dashboard or the dark neon HUD.
